title: Review Core IoT Concepts
description: Revisit the definition of IoT, the roles of smart objects, sensors, actuators, embedded systems, and communication channels.

title: Compare IoT Application Areas
description: Focus on the differences between smart home, medicine, transport, energy, industry, and city infrastructure scenarios.

title: Repeat IoT Threat Classification
description: Review the main threat groups: malicious actions, interception, outages, technical failures, disasters, and physical attacks.

title: Clarify IIoT Risk Patterns
description: Repeat the differences between IoT and IIoT, IT/OT convergence, legacy industrial systems, unsafe protocols, and human factors.

title: Review Practical Attack Scenarios
description: Go back through attack scenarios against sensors, actuators, network connections, management systems, and IoT botnets.

title: Repeat IoT Digital Forensics
description: Revisit evidence sources such as devices, paired smartphones, networks, applications, cloud services, and event logs.

title: Repeat Organizational Controls
description: Return to policy, risk management, responsibility distribution, staff training, and incident readiness.

title: Repeat Technical Controls
description: Revisit access control, authentication, encryption, segmentation, logging, monitoring, and secure update practices.
